 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-55762  Receive the supporting documentation into the record, conclude the public hearing,
  and adopt a Resolution amending fee and changes for parks and recreation
  programs and the use of public parks and recreation facilities for Fiscal Year 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  25-55763  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Parks and Recreation
  Commission meeting of Thursday, June 26, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  25-55764  Recommendation to discuss fee waiver requests received between June 12, 2025
  and July 9, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55767  Recommendation to authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to
  execute a Personal Service Agreement with Elizabeth Gordon to provide free and
  low-cost public cultural arts classes at Department of Parks, Recreation and
  Marine facilities, for a period of one year and one month from September 1, 2025
  to September 30, 2026, with two, two-year options to renew through September
  30, 2030, at the discretion of the Director. (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-55774  Authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to execute a Right-of-Entry
  Permit, and any other necessary documents, with Creative Class Collective, a
  California nonprofit corporation, to enter Lincoln Park for the production and
  maintenance of one mural for a term of one year, from July 21, 2025, through July
  20, 2026, with three, three-year renewal options at the discretion of the Director.
  (District 1)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-55779  Recommendation to receive and file the Director’s monthly highlights report, “We
  Create Community” and “Director’s Highlights” for July 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-55780  Recommendation to request potential topics for future Parks and Recreation
  Commission meetings and/or Parks and Recreation Commission committee
  meetings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR ELECTION

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Parks and Recreation Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker
is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Christine Amaya, Administrative Aide, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.
